thread:
julia-sales: Hey team — Finedge POC hitting errors on rerank endpoint, customer says vectors don't match dims. They can demo if needed. Can we swarm?
michael-cust: Repro steps — we generate embeddings with model text-embed-lite-v1, send to /rerank, get: 
michael-cust: ERROR: InvalidArgument: embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 768
ben-support: Thanks, do you have the raw payload you sent? small sample will help.
michael-cust: sending payload in DM (example): {
  "query": "pricing for enterprise",
  "candidates": [[...768 floats...], [...768 floats...]]
}
ana-eng: Looks like the rerank service expects our catalog embeddings (1536). Are they mixing two models?
julia-sales: Customer said they used an older client library; might default to text-embed-small (768).
ben-support: If true, options: 1) re-run embeddings with 1536 model 2) use encoder param on rerank to accept 768 3) remap via on-the-fly upcast (not ideal).
michael-cust: Is there a config for rerank to accept 768? we can't regenerate 2M docs for POC quickly.
ana-eng: We have a compatibility flag in Dedicated that allows alternate dim, but hosted rerank endpoint currently validates dims strictly.
ana-eng: For a quick POC workaround: you can compute a 1536 vector by concatenating the 768 with zeros — not ideal but can prove flow.
julia-sales: Customer worried about accuracy and cost if they re-run. any short-term routing options?
ben-support: Another approach — run the rerank against their candidate set using our 768-capable reranker in a dedicated job (we can spin a canary pod). That avoids re-embedding everything in S3.
ops-oncall: I can spin a temporary dedicated instance for the POC. Need approval for burst GPUs and quote to sales.
julia-sales: Price question from customer: how much for a week of dedicated for this POC? Need numbers to present.
ana-eng: For a small single-GPU canary it's approx $400/day on our cost model. Julia pls confirm if we can bill as credit.
julia-sales: I'll propose a 7-day trial credit and note potential enterprise commit if SLA/latency good.
ben-support: Also saw intermittent 429s in logs — probably hitting burst limits during batch encode. michael, do you have timestamps for rate-limited requests?
michael-cust: yes — attaching snippet: 
[2026-02-18T15:03:21Z] POST /embed 200 0.34s
[2026-02-18T15:03:22Z] POST /embed 429 RATE_LIMIT
[2026-02-18T15:03:22Z] POST /rerank 400 InvalidArgument: dim mismatch
ana-eng: 429s likely due to simultaneous batch encoding from their script. Recommend adding a 200ms jitter and cap concurrency to 8.
ben-support: Quick repro command to simulate client side: 
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"test"}' &
done
wait
```
This will surface burst limits.
michael-cust: ok will try throttling.
julia-sales: Security question from procurement too — they asked about encryption at rest for the temporary dedicated job. Who owns that answer?
ana-eng: Dedicated uses customer VPC / KMS for Private; for hosted canary we can enable ephemeral volume encryption but need SOC2 note. I'll escalate to security and paste the standard blurb.
ops-oncall: Canary spin-up done: canary-id=c-789, exposes rerank that accepts 768 for testing. URL sent via DM.
michael-cust: hitting the canary now — rerank returned 200 and ranks look sensible. thanks.
ben-support: Nice. For production recommendation: standardize on single embed model across pipeline or add an ingest job to re-embed. We'll document costs.
julia-sales: I'll send pricing >7d and CC contracts. Also adding note to SQA: customer will need SOC2 + KMS details.
ana-eng: Follow-up ticket created: ENG-POC-2314 to add a more permissive compatibility mode in hosted rerank (engineering design + risk).
julia-sales: TY everyone. michael — after you confirm accuracy metrics we'll move to purchase conversation. :thumbsup:
michael-cust: Confirmed — accuracy delta <3% with zero-pad workaround. We'll proceed with the canary week and share final numbers by Friday.
sre-bot: Deploy c-789 -> running on g4dn.xlarge, uptime 3m.
ben-support: Closing this thread for now, will reopen if any regressions.
